Een kwartaalmagazine voor ondernemers di: A quarterly magazine for entrepreneurs who will really set aside a morning for it. Ninety minutes, five moves, your business weighed against the evidence. Free, new every edition, with original analysis of European and Dutch data.
Een eigen analyse op 27 EU-landen, acht: Original analysis of 27 EU countries, eight lenses (psychology, strategy, law, labour, politics, energy, technology and processes) and nine building blocks, each with a concrete Monday action. The worksheets are fillable right in the PDF.
Landen waar kleine bedrijven 43% halen v: Countries where small firms reach 43% of large firms' AI use lead the field; laggards sit at 22%. There is no catch-up: laggards are not growing faster in proportion. And AI use in the Netherlands ranges from 13.8% to 70% depending on definition and population, which is why every figure states what was measured.
